summary.root_cause_text: Order worker thread stalled in a wait state and stopped consuming the queue. The deeper reason it stalled is unknown.
recommended: Find out why the worker entered the wait state and never resumed.

root_causes: Order worker thread stalled in a wait state and stopped consuming the queue. The deeper reason it stalled is unknown.
evidence: queue_depth grew from 26 to 34 while processed stayed at 14
Last worker log: DEBUG worker 'worker entered wait state'
Config and recent_changes show nothing relevant (v1.3 was deployed 25h ago, which doesn't match the incident timing)
args.impact: Up to 34 orders were queued unprocessed (the metrics reported SAR 6087.54 and USD 4743.37 queued, 23875.18 SAR total). No orders were dropped and none were processed without payment. After the restart all 75 orders had payments and queue depth was 0.
recommended_actions: Find out why the worker entered the wait state and never resumed.
Alert on worker heartbeat age and on a queue that keeps growing.
args.summary: The worker stalled and the queue backed up (34 orders) while /health stayed green. I restarted the worker. The queue drained, all 75 orders have payments, and check_invariants is green. The reason the worker stalled is still unknown.
